description.text: This domain is found C-terminal in Lipoprotein N-acyltransferase Lnb from Bacteroides and related uncharacterised bacterial proteins. Lnb functions as a lipoprotein N-acyltransferase in its native cell environment [[cite:PUB00158892]]. It is composed of two domains, N-terminal periplasmic domain and C-terminal α-helical transmembrane domain (this entry) which is predicted to contain five transmembrane helices. This domain is often found associated with [interpro:IPR025178].

PUB00158892.title: Identification and characterization of the lipoprotein <i>N</i>-acyltransferase in <i>Bacteroides</i>.
